summary: Iteration 5 — Sprint 1 of Pro monetization (Stripe Checkout via emergentintegrations). NEW backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_billing.py (12/12 PASS). All Sprint-1 spec items validated: GET /billing/plans returns pro_monthly (R$ 12.90 BRL / 30d) + pro_yearly (R$ 99.00 BRL / 365d); GET /billing/me returns {tier:'free', renews_at:None, days_left:None} for admin; POST /billing/checkout returns real https://checkout.stripe.com/... URL + cs_test_... session_id for both plans; transaction row inserted in payment_transactions with status='initiated', payment_status='unpaid', credited=false, user_id=admin._id; invalid plan='foo' rejected (Pydantic regex → 422 — semantically equivalent to spec's 400); no-auth on /billing/checkout, /billing/me, /billing/status/* → 401; cross-user /billing/status/{session_id} → 404; POST /webhook/stripe with bogus/no signature → 400 (does NOT 500). FRONTEND validated end-to-end: /pricing publicly accessible (no auth), data-testid plan-card-free + plan-card-pro + pricing-period-monthly + pricing-period-yearly all present, monthly default shows R$ 12,90/mês, yearly toggle shows R$ 99,00/ano + strike-through R$ 154,80/ano + '-36%' badge + 'Apenas R$ 8,25/mês — economize 36%'; logged-out pricing-cta-pro → /login; logged-in pricing-cta-pro fires POST /api/billing/checkout (verified via network capture); AppLayout shows nav-upgrade-btn for free admin (verified visually + click navigates to /pricing); /profile shows profile-upgrade-link (no profile-pro-badge), click → /pricing; /billing/success?session_id=BAD_ID renders billing-success-page testid + 'Confirmando seu pagamento...' polling state without crashing (transitions to error state after 12 retries × 2.5s ≈ 30s — verified non-crashing through 12s window). Lint clean on Pricing.jsx + BillingSuccess.jsx. REGRESSION: 79/86 backend tests pass (12/12 NEW billing + 67/74 PRE-EXISTING). 7 PRE-EXISTING streaming failures detected — UNRELATED to billing sprint, see backend_issues.critical below.

critical.issue: Episode objects no longer include 'providers' and 'matched_providers' keys. test_phase3.py::TestStreamingSearch::test_provider_search fails for all 5 providers (Netflix, Prime Video, Disney Plus, HBO Max, Apple TV). REGRESSION vs iter-4. Root cause: streaming endpoint shape changed — episodes now contain only series/episode metadata, not the provider arrays the tests assert on. Either (a) tests need update if shape change is intentional, or (b) endpoint needs to add 'providers' + 'matched_providers' back into each episode.

test_phase4_streaming.py::TestAppleTVPlus::test_apple_tv_{plus_no_paramount_channel,no_channel}_falsepos fail — 'Apple TV+' search now matches 'Apple TV Amazon Channel' (sub-channel false positive). Token-prefix match in _provider_matches is too permissive: needle ['apple','tv'] matches start of ['apple','tv','amazon','channel']. Should reject any provider whose tokens contain 'channel' when needle doesn't. REGRESSION vs iter-4 where _provider_matches had stricter rules.

minor.issue: Invalid plan returns 422 (Pydantic regex validation) instead of 400. Semantically correct (both = bad input) but spec explicitly says 400. Either move plan validation INTO the function body before Pydantic regex, or update spec to accept 422. Test currently accepts both.
(carry-over from iter-3/4) No caching of TMDB /tv/{id}?append_to_response=watch/providers — every search fires N parallel TMDB round-trips. Add 5-15 min in-memory cache.
(carry-over) Broad except still returns 502 for some bogus sessions; main path returns 401 correctly.

action_items: FIX (HIGH): /api/streaming/episodes regression — restore 'providers' + 'matched_providers' keys per episode object, OR update phase3/phase4 tests if shape change is intentional.

FIX (HIGH): _provider_matches Apple TV+ false positive on 'Apple TV Amazon Channel' / similar sub-channel providers. Add a guard rejecting providers ending in 'Channel' when needle doesn't include it, OR make match stricter for 2-token needles.
(Minor) Make /api/billing/checkout return 400 instead of 422 for invalid plan (move validation inside function body) to match spec exactly.
(Optional, perf) Cache TMDB /tv/{id} responses for 5-15 min keyed by tmdb_id.

rca of the issue: Streaming regression RCA: Between iter-4 and iter-5, two changes broke 7 streaming tests. (A) /api/streaming/episodes response shape changed — each episode used to include {providers: [...], matched_providers: [...]} arrays so the frontend could badge each episode with its detected provider; current response omits these keys. (B) _provider_matches() word-token matching now allows ['apple','tv'] to prefix-match ['apple','tv','amazon','channel'] (sub-channel) where iter-4 explicitly blocked it. Fix path (A): re-add providers + matched_providers fields when constructing each episode dict in streaming_episodes(). Fix path (B): in _provider_matches, after computing tokenized needle/haystack, if haystack ends with 'channel' AND needle does NOT contain 'channel', return False — this preserves Disney+ ↔ Disney Plus equivalence while blocking '* Channel' sub-channels.
